layout.title: PIPELINE NOTES
layout.subtitle: How the report is calculated
layout.body:
## What this measures
- Open pipeline excludes Won and Lost deals.
- Weighted forecast uses the deal stage confidence table and `deal_value`.
- Close-date filtering uses `expected_close`.
- The risk list flags deals that are due soon, have not been contacted recently, or have no next action.

## Notes
- The stage selector narrows all pipeline widgets to the chosen stage.
- Open pipeline review is still a note-level proxy until deals expose richer risk fields such as structured aging or last-activity rollups.

reports.sales.title: Sales Report
reports.sales.subtitle: Closed wins, losses and close timing

layout.title: SALES NOTES
layout.subtitle: How capture rate and timing are read
layout.body:
## What this measures
- Revenue and lost value use the selected owner, source, client and close-date filters.
- Capture rate is the won value divided by won plus lost value for the current filter set.
- The close-date chart uses `expected_close` as the only available timing field, so it shows raw close dates until period buckets are materialized.

## Notes
- Source and client selectors are proxies for pipeline slicing until the deal schema carries richer account rollups.

layout.title: ACTIVITY NOTES
layout.subtitle: How the activity counts are grouped
layout.body:
## What this measures
- Meetings count channel = `meeting`.
- Calls + messages count `call`, `email`, `telegram`, and `whatsapp`.
- Follow-ups are activity notes whose `next_action_date` is due or overdue.
- The channel selector narrows every widget on the report.

## Notes
- There is no owner field in the current activity fallback schema, so owner-based slicing is not enabled yet.

layout.title: BURN-DOWN RATE
layout.caption: closed vs created
layout.sub: Tasks closed divided by tasks created over the last 30 days. Above 100% the backlog is shrinking.

layout.title: PRODUCTIVITY NOTES
layout.subtitle: How backlog and flow are separated
layout.body:
## What this measures
- BACKLOG, OVERDUE and STALE are point-in-time totals over every TaskNote, with no date window applied.
- CREATED, CLOSED and NET cover the last 30 days only. NET is created minus closed, so a positive number means the backlog grew.
- BURN-DOWN RATE is closed divided by created over the same 30 days. Above 100% you are closing faster than you add.
- The heatmap and the project/context splits remain windowed views of recent activity, not backlog totals.

## Notes
- A task with no explicit created date falls back to file creation time; a closed task with no completion date falls back to last-modified.
- Cancelled tasks are excluded everywhere.

layout.title: PARTNER NOTES
layout.subtitle: How partner attribution is counted
layout.body:
## What this measures
- Partner counts and the partner list respect the selected partner status.
- Deal attribution currently uses `deal_source == "partner"` as a proxy because deal records do not yet expose `partner_ref`.
- Open commissions and expiring certifications are evidence lists, not summary dashboards.

reports.kpi.subtitle: Value-chain KPIs — auto-refreshed weekly from vault entities

layout.title: How this works
layout.body:
Each KPI note is refreshed weekly by the **KPI Weekly Refresh** scheduled task (`kpi_refresh.py`, owner-priority-system). Computed from vault entities: pipeline, AR overdue, **AP overdue (procure-to-pay)** from supplier invoices, clients, capacity, publishing cadence, and **days since last release (concept-to-launch)** from `40-PRODUCTS/*/release-notes/`. Cash balance and MRR come from manual inputs in `kpi_refresh_config.yaml` and are flagged stale after 21 days. Product release cadence is surfaced but excluded from the overall roll-up (lumpy/monthly).

- **Definitions & thresholds**: `20-COMPANY/80-MANAGEMENT/KPI-REGISTRY.md` (31 KPIs)
- **Chain coverage & gaps**: `VALUE-CHAINS.md`
- **Trend history**: `20-COMPANY/80-MANAGEMENT/REPORTS/kpi/kpi_history.json`

  timeEstimateCategory: if(!timeEstimate || timeEstimate == 0, "No estimate", if(timeEstimate < 30, "Quick (<30m)", if(timeEstimate <= 120, "Medium (30m-2h)", "Long (>2h)")))
  ageCategory: if(((number(now()) - number(file.ctime)) / 86400000) < 1, "Today", if(((number(now()) - number(file.ctime)) / 86400000) < 7, "This week", if(((number(now()) - number(file.ctime)) / 86400000) < 30, "This month", "Older")))
  createdMonth: file.ctime.format("YYYY-MM")
  modifiedMonth: file.mtime.format("YYYY-MM")
  priorityCategory: if(priority=="none","None",if(priority=="low","Low",if(priority=="normal","Normal",if(priority=="high","High","No priority"))))
  projectCount: if(!projects || list(projects).length == 0, "No projects", if(list(projects).length == 1, "Single project", "Multiple projects"))
  contextCount: if(!contexts || list(contexts).length == 0, "No contexts", if(list(contexts).length == 1, "Single context", "Multiple contexts"))
  trackingStatus: if(!timeEstimate || timeEstimate == 0, "No estimate", if(!timeEntries || list(timeEntries).length == 0, "Not started", if(formula.efficiencyRatio < 100, "Under estimate", "Over estimate")))
  nextDate: if(due && scheduled, if(date(due) < date(scheduled), due, scheduled), if(due, due, scheduled))
  daysUntilNext: if(due && scheduled, min(formula.daysUntilDue, formula.daysUntilScheduled), if(due, formula.daysUntilDue, formula.daysUntilScheduled))
  hasDate: due || scheduled
  isToday: (due && date(due).date() == today()) || (scheduled && date(scheduled).date() == today())
  isThisWeek: (due && date(due) >= today() && date(due) <= today() + "7d") || (scheduled && date(scheduled) >= today() && date(scheduled) <= today() + "7d")
  nextDateCategory: if(!due && !scheduled, "No date", if((due && date(due) < today()) || (scheduled && date(scheduled) < today()), "Overdue/Past", if((due && date(due).date() == today()) || (scheduled && date(scheduled).date() == today()), "Today", if((due && date(due).date() == today() + "1d") || (scheduled && date(scheduled).date() == today() + "1d"), "Tomorrow", if((due && date(due) <= today() + "7d") || (scheduled && date(scheduled) <= today() + "7d"), "This week", "Later")))))
  nextDateMonth: if(due && scheduled, if(date(due) < date(scheduled), date(due).format("YYYY-MM"), date(scheduled).format("YYYY-MM")), if(due, date(due).format("YYYY-MM"), if(scheduled, date(scheduled).format("YYYY-MM"), "No date")))

  dueDateDisplay: if(!due, "", if(date(due).date() == today(), "Today", if(date(due).date() == today() + "1d", "Tomorrow", if(date(due).date() == today() - "1d", "Yesterday", if(date(due) < today(), formula.daysUntilDue * -1 + "d ago", if(date(due) <= today() + "7d", date(due).format("ddd"), date(due).format("MMM D")))))))

schemas.accounting-period:
entity: accounting-period
label: Accounting Period

location_pattern: 20-COMPANY/06-FINANCE/PERIODS/
description: Accounting Period entity from DATAMODEL.md
key_fields:
- period_id
- period_type
- start_date
- end_date
- status
- currency
fields:
- name: type
  type: string
  required: true
- name: period_id
  type: string
  required: true
  description: e.g. 2025-12, 2025-Q4, 2025
- name: period_type
  type: string
  required: true
  enum:
  - monthly
  - quarterly
  - annual
- name: start_date
  type: string
  format: date
  required: true
  description: First day of period
- name: end_date
  type: string
  format: date
  required: true
  description: Last day of period
- name: status
  type: string
  required: true
  enum:
  - open
  - soft-closed
  - hard-closed
- name: currency
  type: string
  required: true
  description: Functional currency (AED for UAE entities; EUR for BE)
- name: client_id
  required: false
  type: string
  description: kebab-case client identifier. Populated for client periods under 30-CLIENTS/.
    Omitted for own-company periods
- name: purpose
  required: false
  type: string
  enum:
  - live-books
  - audit-reference
- name: approved_by
  required: false
  type: string
  description: 'Required when status: hard-closed'
- name: approved_date
  required: false
  type: string
  format: date
  description: 'Required when status: hard-closed'
- name: tags
  required: true
  type: array
  description: Must include accounting-period
status_lifecycle:
- open
- soft-closed
- hard-closed
schemas.activity:
entity: activity
label: Activity

location_pattern: 30-CLIENTS/{client-id}/03-COMMS/
description: Activity entity from DATAMODEL.md
key_fields:
- title

- direction
- client_id
- lead_id
- contact_ref
- date
- related
